data.name: Subhojit
data.gender_notes: Subhojit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Subho means new beginning and auspicious. Jit means victory. Subhojit means one who has achieved a new beginning or has the auspicious qualities of a victor. The name Subhojit carries the meaning “New Beginning, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Subhojit usually hope their child will grow to embody new beginning, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Subhojit is a name with strong spiritual meaning, representing the beginning of a new spiritual journey or the victory over negative energies.
data.etymology: Subhojit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “New Beginning, Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Subhojit total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Subhojit carries a rich cultural significance in Hindu tradition. In Hinduism, the concept of "Shubh Aarambh" (auspicious beginning) holds great importance. The name Subhojit symbolizes this idea and shows that one is believed to have a fresh start with auspicious qualities and is ready to overcome challenges.
data.spiritual_significance: Subhojit holds a significant spiritual meaning. It represents the inner victory that one gains after overcoming personal challenges and transitions in life. The name is believed to inspire confidence and the inner strength to overcome obstacles and achieve success. It signifies the transformation of a person from a state of struggle to a state of victory and happiness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Subhojit: Bringer of Auspiciousness and Blessings. Embodiment of Good Fortune.

historical_references.reference: Subhojit was a renowned Hindu scholar and philosopher during the Gupta Empire (320-550 AD). He was a key figure in the revival of learning in ancient India.
Subhojit is also mentioned in the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata where he is described as a great sage and a learned priest.

modern_usage.modern_context: Subhojit is a modern name that resonates with individuals in the technology, digital marketing, and entrepreneurship industries. On Twitter, he is known for sharing insightful thoughts on digital marketing trends and engaging with industry leaders. On Facebook, Subhojit frequently shares posts about his entrepreneurial journey and inspirational stories of successful business owners.
